about: Every Omarchy bar item and its Fathom dropdown (#14). fathom: the Fathom plugin that replaces it (a clone of it, see bar/README.md); planned: what its dropdown will hold; none: why it has none. tests/test_bar.py fails when Omarchy has a bar item this list doesn't name.

omarchy.audio.how: the bar's cluster: one button for Bluetooth, network, volume and battery, opening Quick settings

omarchy.tailscale.planned: the tailnet: on or off, exit node, machines, copy an address

omarchy.agents.planned: each AI agent's usage, limits and balance

omarchy.elsewhen.planned: the world clock: the time in each city

omarchy.dropbox.planned: Dropbox's status, storage and recent files

omarchy.keyboard-layout.planned: the layouts, to pick one (a click cycles them today)

omarchy.microphone.planned: the microphone: mute, level and input (a click mutes it today)

omarchy.indicators.planned: each indicator (Do not disturb, night light, stay awake, ...) with its switch

omarchy.system-update.planned: what the update brings, and Update now (a click starts it today)

omarchy.tray.planned: each app's tray menu in Fathom's look

omarchy.menu.planned: to be decided: Omarchy's menu, or Fathom's Start

omarchy.workspaces.planned: to be decided (a click goes to the workspace today)

omarchy.active-window.planned: to be decided: the window's actions (snap, float, close, move)

omarchy.spacer.none: blank space between items, with nothing to open
